checks.claim: Anthropic financial-services README defines the repo as reference agents, skills, and data connectors for financial-services workflows.

The README lists ten named agents: Pitch Agent, Meeting Prep Agent, Market Researcher, Earnings Reviewer, Model Builder, Valuation Reviewer, GL Reconciler, Month-End Closer, Statement Auditor, and KYC Screener.
The README lists MCP integrations for Daloopa, Morningstar, S&P Global, FactSet, Moody's, MT Newswires, Aiera, LSEG, PitchBook, Chronograph, and Egnyte.
The README says the same source can be installed as a Claude Cowork plugin or deployed through Claude Managed Agents API behind a firm's workflow engine.
The repository includes Microsoft 365 install tooling for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook, and can use Vertex AI, Bedrock, or an internal LLM gateway.
Anthropic's 2026-05-05 official post announces 10 ready-to-run agent templates for financial workflows.
Advancing Claude for Financial Services expands Claude for Excel beta and describes preserving formulas, formatting, and dependencies.
The article's thesis that Anthropic is selling default workflow structure is an editorial synthesis, not a direct quote from Anthropic.

cautions: The article intentionally does not claim customer production adoption.
The article intentionally treats connector access as conditional because provider subscriptions/API keys may be required.
